h1: Kaibae Beach Resort — Beachfront Bungalows on Kai Bae Where You Step Straight Into the Sea
intro: Picture this: you open your room door to find sand and sea right in front of you, a few steps to the water, with sun loungers under the trees for watching the sea all day — Kaibae Beach Resort is a beachfront resort of around 59 rooms set in the heart of Kai Bae Beach, one of the beaches many travellers choose on Koh Chang because it balances quiet with convenience. The draw is simple: you sleep right on the sand and can walk from your room straight into the sea. There are rooms in the building block and bungalows on the beach, a pool with a kids' pool, and a central location within walking distance of Kai Bae's restaurants and convenience stores. Rooms start from approx. ฿1,500/night.

body.html: What makes Kaibae Beach Resort stand out on Kai Bae is exactly what its name promises: it really is on the sand. The resort runs all the way down to the water, with rooms in the block at the back and bungalows closer to the beach — a few steps from your door and you're on the sand. Out front there are sun loungers under the trees and beach seating areas to spend the whole day. That's the difference from many places on the island that sit across the road and make you cross to reach the beach — here you walk out of your room and the sea is right there.

Rooms come in several types depending on location and view, from budget-friendly Superior/Deluxe rooms in the building block to bungalows and beachfront rooms that sit closer to the water with better views. Inside they're air-conditioned, with tiled or wooden floors, kept simple in beach-resort style, with flat-screen TVs, fridge/minibar, safe and hot-water bathrooms. Many have private balconies, and some beachfront rooms add a deck or rooftop sitting area. Real guest reviews agree on the same point: the best value here is getting a room on the sand at a price that's still affordable compared with other beachfront resorts on the island.
"Open the door and the sea is right there — a few steps to the water. In the evening you can sit and watch the sunset from the beach. Great value for the price."

The shared facilities include an outdoor pool with a kids' pool and a small slide, which is why families pick this place so often. There's a beach restaurant and bar, a coffee shop, and breakfast with Asian and Western options included in many packages. Massage/spa, free parking and a counter for booking snorkelling and island trips round it out. The sweet spot is that it's central to Kai Bae, walkable to restaurants, convenience stores and tour counters, so you don't need a ride for every meal — yet it isn't the loud party strip you get at Lonely Beach.

To be straight with you: at low tide Kai Bae shows compacted sand with rocks in places, the water isn't always crystal-clear, and some seasons bring seaweed — that's the nature of this stretch, not a postcard white-sand beach. Some reviews mention rooms that look dated or air-con/TV issues in certain rooms, and inconsistent food quality in the restaurant. A few note that beach sun loungers are limited, and returning guests have observed prices creeping up. None of it is serious, but it's worth knowing to set expectations right.

The location is Kai Bae Beach on the west coast of Koh Chang, just south of Klong Prao and White Sand Beach. It's a few minutes' walk to the area's restaurants and convenience stores, about 10 minutes' drive to Klong Prao, 10–15 minutes to Lonely Beach, and roughly 25–35 minutes from the ferry pier. The overall score sits around 8.4 from real guest reviews (some platforms go as high as ~9.0), and TripAdvisor ranks it near the top of its category on the island — numbers that match its character: strong on beachfront location, value and friendly staff, with room condition and the nature of the beach pulling it down a little.

Bottom line: Kaibae Beach Resort suits travellers who want a genuine beachfront stay where you walk from your room into the sea, at a price that's still affordable, with a pool and kids' pool for families. Families with children, couples who want to sleep on the sand, and travellers who want to be central to Kai Bae near the restaurants will like it here. But if you expect a postcard white-sand, crystal-clear beach year-round, pristine new rooms, or luxury-resort service, a 4-star or higher property on Klong Prao or White Sand will be a better fit.

A tip from reading the reviews: if you're here to sleep on the sand, ask for a bungalow or beachfront room as close to the water as possible — the view and atmosphere are clearly different from rooms in the back block. In high season (November–February) Kai Bae gets busy and beachfront rooms fill fast, so book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate. In the rainy season (May–October) prices drop a lot but the sea can be rough and some activities are limited — check before you book.

faqTitle: FAQ — Kaibae Beach Resort Koh Chang

faq.q: Is Kaibae Beach Resort on the beach? Can you walk straight into the sea?
faq.a: Yes, it's genuinely on Kai Bae Beach. The resort runs down to the water, with rooms in the building block and bungalows on the beach. Beachfront rooms are just a few steps from the sea, with sun loungers and seating areas on the sand. One thing to know: at low tide the beach has compacted sand and rocks in places, and some seasons bring seaweed — that's the nature of this stretch of coast.

faq.q: Where on Koh Chang is Kaibae Beach Resort?
faq.a: It's on Kai Bae Beach, on the west coast of Koh Chang, just south of Klong Prao and White Sand Beach. It's a few minutes' walk to the area's restaurants and convenience stores, about 10 minutes' drive to Klong Prao, 10–15 minutes to Lonely Beach, and roughly 25–35 minutes from the ferry pier.

faq.q: How much does Kaibae Beach Resort cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx. ฿1,500/night for a Superior room in the building block. Deluxe rooms start around ฿1,900, beachfront bungalows around ฿2,800, and family rooms around ฿3,500 and up. Prices swing a lot by season — rainy season (May–Oct) and booking ahead are clearly cheaper, so compare a few platforms before you book.

faq.q: Is Kaibae Beach Resort good for families with kids?
faq.a: Yes. It has an outdoor pool with a kids' pool and a small slide, plus a beachfront location where you walk straight into the sea, which makes it a frequent pick for families. There are family rooms for 3–4 guests, and it's central to the area within walking distance of restaurants.

faq.q: What are the highlights and things to know about Kaibae Beach Resort?
faq.a: The highlights are its genuine beachfront location on Kai Bae, the pool with a kids' pool, and the value, along with friendly staff. Things to know: at low tide the beach has rocks and some seasons bring seaweed, some rooms show wear with occasional air-con/TV issues, and restaurant food quality is inconsistent.

faq.q: Who is Kaibae Beach Resort for, and who is it not for?
faq.a: It suits families with children, couples who want to sleep on the sand, and travellers who want to be central to Kai Bae at an affordable price. It may not suit those expecting a postcard white-sand, crystal-clear beach year-round, pristine new rooms, or luxury-resort service — for that, a 4-star or higher resort on Klong Prao or White Sand is a better fit.
